chunks: That was narrated by Musa ibn al-Qasim from Safwan ibn Yahya from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who entered into Ihram for Hajj al-Mufrad, then entered Mecca, performed Tawaf around the House, and Sa'i between As-Safa and Al-Marwah. He said: 'He should exit Ihram and make it a Tamattu' Hajj, unless he had brought the sacrificial animal (Hady), in which case he cannot exit Ihram until the sacrificial animal reaches its place of sacrifice.'

key_terms.سَعَى: Performed Sa'i (walking between Safa and Marwah)
key_terms.لَبَّى: Entered into the state of Ihram for Hajj
key_terms.مُتْعَةً: Tamattu' (a type of Hajj combining Umrah and Hajj with a break in Ihram)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a Mufrad pilgrim who completes Tawaf and Sa'i before the 8th of Dhu al-Hijjah?
ai.summary: This ruling from al-Istibsar clarifies the transition from Hajj al-Mufrad to Hajj al-Tamattu' when the pilgrim performs Umrah rituals early, emphasizing the distinction between voluntary early completion and the mandatory waiting period for those who brought a Hady. It reflects the practical jurisprudence of the Imams regarding the flexibility of Ihram status based on the pilgrim's specific sacrificial obligations.
